test_title: PYST 58: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All caves are houses.

All houses are dens.

All dens are mansions.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All caves are mansions.

(II) Some mansions are houses.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

All caves are houses.

All houses are dens.

All dens are mansions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02746a5989e8a449730691d846b4edcb801b4f74131b318f8802930924498f70.png] 

**Checking Conclusions:**

**(I) All caves are mansions: Follows** (because, All Caves are Houses. All Houses are Dens and All dens are Mansion.So all caves are definitely mansions.)

**(II) Some mansions are houses:** **Follows** (because all houses are mansions. Therefore, some mansions are houses.)

Therefore, **both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
